title: rcf define ledger CLI verb
description: Wraps src/define/ledgers.js with parseArgs and per-verb usage text. Dispatches ledger <name> <verb> where name is brief | decisions | concerns | probes and verb is add | resolve | list. renderDecisionsList prints the numbered #241 format (one decision per item, letter) options, default:, blocks:). list --json emits { ledger, <arrayKey>: [...] }. bin/rcf.js registers this under GROUPS.define.ledger; src/cli/help.js wires HELP into HELP_MAP.define.ledger and extends the DEFINE_HELP and top-level listing blocks so 'rcf help define ledger' and 'rcf define ledger --help' render the same text by construction.
